test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Satheesh starts from a bus-stand and travels 6 km towards the north. He then takes a right turn, travels 2 km, turns right and travels 11 km. He then takes a right turn and travels 5 km. He takes a final right turn, travels 3 km and stops at a junction. In which direction is the bus-stand with respect to the junction? (All turns are 90° turns only.)
solution:
From the given information:

1) Satheesh starts from a bus-stand and travels 6 km towards the north.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c899cb3b355081a992ae56f081ef48bdc2fef4b2da1bdd8b30d1e4e9fed7d943.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13f779525ec98678cd0e0fefa79e0aff9ee09a208a57262e13b3540561353f82.png] 

2) He then takes a right turn and travels 2 km.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8880c36410fc6a45a40ffd0b09a0e3e195c6481eb84a0ca514550286b9832c4.png] 

3) He again turns right and travels 11 km.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbca1af9b2f5091a17447fa430dbb559cdae2bea80658c4404694d6e995ae357.png] 

4) He then takes a right turn and travels 5 km.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9fc872d66b4f3feb1ca0852a7acd6e469e4e534dcbf9cf9fdb2258ba6044fbb.png] 

5) He takes a final right turn, travels 3 km and stops at a junction. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba7e7bb26782a9d986570d7d7dd2e2c6a2ff4bf999128336a3e876a09b7d034c.png] 

Here, we can see that the bus stand is towards the north-east direction of the junction.

Hence, the correct answer is **" North - east "**.
